photoComparison.rationale: Monkey is the research candidate; own field photography remains a competing approach until recognition, topo framing and evidence cost can be compared on actual artifacts.

currentEvidenceComparison.recognition: Own neutral full-face photographs would capture supported exterior identity and irregular small-scale details directly; a coarse research proxy could test broad identity but cannot yet establish guide recognition.
currentEvidenceComparison.startFinishVisibility: Existing capture crops/occlusions leave start/finish correspondence unresolved. Own face-specific images can deliberately include both with breathing room.
currentEvidenceComparison.routeSeparation: Neither route separation in an approved photo nor in an actual render has been tested. Choose own views around corners where one view is insufficient.
currentEvidenceComparison.cameraFreedom: Reconstruction would offer camera freedom only after missing geometry is captured. Present camera freedom would expose guessed roof/back/ground geometry.
currentEvidenceComparison.uncertainty: Own photographs reduce visible-face geometry uncertainty; multi-view measurements still needed for movable geometry. Direct-specific current condition observation remains necessary in either workflow.
currentEvidenceComparison.effortAndAvailability: No field date/access/person availability established. A dedicated photo walk requires travel but can gather lawful guide images, current observations, scale and bearing in one visit; a defensible reconstruction also needs much of that evidence plus authoring/critique/review.
currentEvidenceComparison.preferredNextApproach: Obtain own/permitted face-specific multi-view photos and condition observations; compare an actual exterior study only after their missing facts resolve. Do not force successful reconstruction verdict.
